newsitem.title: USA: True North to buy Bozell for $440 mln.
newsitem.headline: True North to buy Bozell for $440 mln.

text.p: True North Communications Inc, an advertising agency, said Thursday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Bozell, Jacobs, Kenyon and Eckhardt Inc in a transaction valued at about $440 million.

The deal, which had been expected, would create the sixth largest advertising agency in the world, with more than $11.5 billion in annual billings and more than 11,000 employees in 297 offices around the world, True North said.

True North said the agreement virtually doubles its size, with projected revenues of $1.2 billion. As part of the deal approved by both boards, True North will issue 0.51 shares of stock for each share of Bozell.

True North said it expects the transaction to be accretive to earnings in the first full year, which will be 1998. The company said it expects to take a restructuring charge, in an amount to be determined in the quarter in which the transaction closes.
Closing of the deal, which is subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals, is expected during the fourth quarter.
As a result of the merger, True North holding company will have two independent global advertising agencies -- Foote, Cone & Belding Worldwide and Bozell Worldwide.
True North said it gains a leading position in the area of interactive digital technology by adding Bozell's Poppe Tyson to its businesses that include TN Technologies.

True North also will add another U.S. agency, Temerlin McClain, and will establish more significant positions in fast-growing, high-margin integrated marketing services with a laregr healthcare position, additional sales promotion operations and world's eighth largest strategic communications and public relations firm, Bozell Sawyer Miller Group.

"With this transaction we accomplish two of the primary goals we established with the formation of True North in 1995: first, we now have multiple global advertising brands; and second, we're the clear leader in the important growth area of interactive digital technology," Bruce Mason, chairman, said.

Mason will serve as chief executive officer while Charles Peebler Jr., chief executive officer of Bozell, will become president of the combined holding company. Peebler also will be chairman and chief executive officer of True North Diversified Companies, comprising all operations other than Foote, Cone & Belding Worldwide and Bozell Worldwide.
True North appointed Richard Braddock, an outside director since 1994, to be non-executive chairman with responsibility for board activities and board oversight of the integration.
